title: Isolating the Reward Model Overfit Step in the RLHF Causal Chain

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Targeting spurious correlation in reward models at training time is earlier in the causal chain and potentially cheaper than correcting policy behavior post-hoc. Direct practical guidance for reward model training.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training reward models with controlled spurious correlations, then training downstream RL policies and measuring exploitation. The full pipeline (reward model training + RL training + evaluation) is complex and requires significant infrastructure.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple reward model variants, each requiring downstream policy training and evaluation. The controlled-corruption + RL training + behavioral measurement pipeline has many moving parts. Exceeds 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
